verdict_text: NO. The merge formula computes `tmp = base + λ(ft1-base)` then `tmp + λ(ft2-tmp)`, which equals `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-tmp)` — the second task vector is taken against `tmp` (already modified by the first merge), not against the unmodified base. This violates the ordering requirement in step 2/Objective: `out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X]-base[X]) + λ(ft2[X]-base[X])`, which requires both task vectors computed relative to the original base, not sequentially against an intermediate result.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
